SELECT u.id AS id, u.login_name AS loginName, u.display_name AS displayName, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, un.unit_name AS unitName, un.status AS unitStatus, u.status AS accountStatus, u.authorization_version AS authorizationVersion,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_code ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.status = 'ENABLED') AS aggregatedRoleCodes, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.status = 'ENABLED') AS aggregatedRoleNames FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_unit un ON un.id = u.unit_id WHERE u.login_name = CONVERT(#{loginName} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin
SELECT u.status AS accountStatus, un.status AS unitStatus, u.authorization_version AS authorizationVersion FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_unit un ON un.id = u.unit_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
